bills.title: Corporations Amendment (Improving Outcomes for Litigation Funding Participants) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-11-25.37.1) to a motion, which means it failed. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and, in respect of the [Corporations Amendment (Improving Outcomes for Litigation Funding Participants) Bill 2021](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr6802%22), the provisions of the bill be referred immediately to the Economics Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 24 March 2022".*
